1.4.1.description:
Raccoin Archipelago Mod - Version 1.4.1

THE AP SHOP FEATURE CANNOT BE TOGGLED OFF IN THIS VERSION
The options to customize this feature will be added to the yaml eventually, once more ways to obtain checks are implemented
That being said:

This version is just to fix a bug where the Prizeball Item cap was stuck at 50. 

Installation Instructions
(Note: You must have BepInEx installed for RACCOIN before using this mod. BepInEx 6.0.0-be.755 (IL2CPP version) is included below)

Download the RaccoinArchipelago_v1.4zip file attached below.

Extract the ZIP file.

Drag and drop all three .dll files directly into your game's BepInEx/plugins/ folder:

RaccoinArchipelago.dll

Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll

Newtonsoft.Json.dll

(Make sure not to create a new folder inside BepInEx/Plugins)

Launch the game, click the Archipelago Connect button (F3 by default), and enter your server details.

v1.2.description:
CHANGE LOG:
Improved coin placement logic

YAML has been expanded from its basic testing state to include some customizible options.

Added a goal: Complete wave 15 with all 6 characters

Milestones now expect the player to have recieved a number of chracters before they can start to have items placed in them
to prevent a players starting progression from being placed behind scoring 1,000,000,000 points.

Cleaned up item IDs to remove junk coins that arent actually unlockable (ores, cooked food, etc)

Added a starting coin pool (configurable in the yaml!)

Installation Instructions
(Note: You must have BepInEx installed for RACCOIN before using this mod. BepInEx 6.0.0-be.755 (IL2CPP version) is recommended)

Download the RaccoinArchipelago_v1.2.zip file attached below.

Extract the ZIP file.

Drag and drop all three .dll files directly into your game's BepInEx/plugins/ folder:

RaccoinArchipelago.dll

Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll

Newtonsoft.Json.dll

(Make sure not to create a new folder inside BepInEx/Plugins)

Launch the game, click the Archipelago Connect button (F3 by default), and enter your server details.

How to Play
Once connected, simply play RACCOIN! Catch the purple AP balls as they fall off the edge to send locations. The ingame milestone tracker will send a check every time you hit a score milestone (these are cumulative and count between consecutive runs, so you dont have to worry about needing to restart or failing runs)

You can check what the score milestones are by clicking Collections > Score Milestone from Raccoins main menu.

Assets Included Below:

The BepInEx version required ton se this mod

RaccoinArchipelago_v1.0.zip (Contains the mod and required networking dependencies)

raccoin.apworld (The server files for your Archipelago host to place in Archipelago/lib/worlds)
v1.2.title: Raccoin Archipelago v1.2

v1.4.description:
Raccoin Archipelago Mod - Version 1.4

THE AP SHOP FEATURE CANNOT BE TOGGLED OFF IN THIS VERSION
The options to customize this feature will be added to the yaml eventually, once more ways to obtain checks are implemented
That being said:

What's New for Players
Tiered Wallet Progression: You now start your journey with a basic wallet that can only hold 200 tickets. You’ll need to find Progressive Wallet upgrades hidden across the multiworld to expand your storage capacity to 500, 1,000, and eventually, Unlimited.

Shop Economy: Prices in the AP Shop scale to match your wallet upgrades. This creates a natural progression where you’ll need to secure more wallet capacity to afford progression items.

Shop Transparency: When you visit an Archipelago shop, you will now see exactly which items are waiting for you, along with the name of the player who will receive the item you purchase.

Character Shops: Each character has their own AP Shop, and you can be expected to switch characters to revisit shops and earn tickets once you've gotten the right wallet upgrade.

Installation Instructions
(Note: You must have BepInEx installed for RACCOIN before using this mod. BepInEx 6.0.0-be.755 (IL2CPP version) is included below)

Download the RaccoinArchipelago_v1.4zip file attached below.

Extract the ZIP file.

Drag and drop all three .dll files directly into your game's BepInEx/plugins/ folder:

RaccoinArchipelago.dll

Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll

Newtonsoft.Json.dll

(Make sure not to create a new folder inside BepInEx/Plugins)

Launch the game, click the Archipelago Connect button (F3 by default), and enter your server details.
v1.4.title: Raccoin Archipelago v1.4

v1.4-beta.description:
Raccoin Archipelago Mod - Version 1.4 beta
This version of Raccoin Archipelago is intended to be used as a public test of the new shop system. 
Please note that, while testing has been done before release to ensure the features work, there is the possibility of unforseen bugs.
For that reason I dont recommend trying this release in any large multiworlds.

THE AP SHOP FEATURE CANNOT BE TOGGLED OFF IN THIS VERSION
The options to customize this feature will be added to the yaml once enough testing is done on this version.

That being said:

What's New for Players
Tiered Wallet Progression: You now start your journey with a basic wallet that can only hold 200 tickets. You’ll need to find Progressive Wallet upgrades hidden across the multiworld to expand your storage capacity to 500, 1,000, and eventually, Unlimited.

Smart Shop Economy: Prices in the AP Shop  scale to match your wallet upgrades. This creates a natural progression where you’ll need to secure more wallet capacity to afford the most powerful items in the game. 

Shop Transparency: When you visit an Archipelago shop, you will now see exactly which items are waiting for you, along with the name of the player who will receive the item you purchase.

Dynamic Character Shops: Each character has their own AP Shop, and you can be expected to switch characters to revisit shops and earn tickets once you've gotten the right wallet upgrade.

Installation Instructions
(Note: You must have BepInEx installed for RACCOIN before using this mod. BepInEx 6.0.0-be.755 (IL2CPP version) is included below)

Download the RaccoinArchipelago_v1.4 beta.zip file attached below.

Extract the ZIP file.

Drag and drop all three .dll files directly into your game's BepInEx/plugins/ folder:

RaccoinArchipelago.dll

Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll

Newtonsoft.Json.dll

(Make sure not to create a new folder inside BepInEx/Plugins)

Launch the game, click the Archipelago Connect button (F3 by default), and enter your server details.
